# How JTC cut model checking time by 95% with Plannerly

JTC Corporation, under Singapore's Ministry of Trade and Industry, moved its 11,000-row Excel requirements into Plannerly and automated its model checks. Checks that took weeks now take hours.

[Download the case study (PDF)  (opens in a new tab)](https://plannerly.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/JTC-Cuts-Model-Checking-Time-by-95-Using-Plannerly-for-Smart-Information-Management.pdf) [Book a live demo](https://plannerly.com/meeting/)

## The results, in JTC's own figures

- **95%** Faster model validationJTC Corporation, Singapore
- **11,000** Excel rows eliminatedMoved into structured templates in Plannerly
- **2,000+** Object types defined across 27 model categoriesJTC's Model Content Requirements (MCR)

## About JTC

JTC Corporation, under Singapore's Ministry of Trade and Industry, is the national agency driving industrial infrastructure development. JTC manages the full project lifecycle - from planning and design to construction, facility management and estate rejuvenation - so accurate, structured data is essential for moving smoothly between project phases.

## The challenge

With projects spanning many stakeholders and phases, JTC faced:

- An 11,000-row Excel document holding its Model Content Requirements (MCR)
- Manual, inconsistent compliance checks
- Different data expectations across consultants, contractors and FM teams
- No easy way to track model progress or data quality over time

> Compliance checks used to be a black box. Now, with Plannerly's Verify module, every requirement is traceable and auditable.

LO**Lok** JTC Implementation Partner

## What JTC did

In 2023, JTC started using Plannerly to host, standardise and automate its Model Content Requirements.

### Moved the requirements out of Excel

The team moved more than 11,000 rows of data from Excel into structured templates, and defined 2,000+ object types across 27 model categories and 300+ subcategories.

### Gave every role its responsibilities

Modelling responsibilities were assigned with role-based filtering.

### Automated the model checks

Weekly (or more frequent) model checks run automatically in the Verify module, with the results on visual dashboards using red, yellow and green compliance indicators.

### Launched MCR 2.0

By 2024, JTC launched MCR 2.0, fully integrated with Plannerly workflows and aligned with IFC SG standards.

## The impact

- **95% less model-checking effort**
- Compliance workflows that are auditable and traceable
- Faster coordination through partial model check-ins
- People in non-BIM roles can take part
- The MCR is now expanding to infrastructure projects

In their own words

> Before Plannerly, it took weeks to do model checks - now we do it in hours.

JK![](https://plannerly.com/web-assets/face-john-kiong-1fcf9687eb570786.webp)**John Kiong** Director, Future of Building & Infrastructure Division, JTC Corporation
